narrative.overview: VAGANCIA FITNESS applies VP Black Paper, a red accent and ivory text to a native iOS 26 app. The protected header combines the v8 eye and v7 outlined wordmark. Asimovian leads titles, Inter organizes the interface and Lekton marks metadata; controls and Liquid Glass are native. Each metric retains its unit and provenance. VaganciaFitnessDebug remains an independent diagnostic app with its own installation identity.
keyCharacteristics: VP Black Paper: #080808, #141416 and #242428; red #F02D2A and fire #FF6247.
V8 eye and v7 outlined wordmark in an 88 × 30 pt header.
Asimovian 400, Inter 400/600/700, Lekton 400 and SF monospaced digits.
Native iOS 26 SwiftUI controls and Liquid Glass.
Accessible summary with complete units and sources; demonstration data is identified.

rules.name: Visible provenance
rules.body: Keep unit and source next to each value; a target or simulated value is not a physical measurement.

rules.name: System materials
rules.body: Use SwiftUI styles and materials for navigation, sheets, controls and Liquid Glass.

rules.name: Vector brand
rules.body: Use the approved v8 eye and v7 outlined wordmark vectors; preserve the compact header.

dos: **Do** preserve the four tabs, NavigationStack, Form, List, sheets and Apple SF Symbols.
**Do** use the VP Black Paper palette and bundled licensed fonts.
**Do** preserve Dynamic Type and rearrange groups at accessibility sizes.
**Do** label metrics with unit and source and separate Planned, Effective and Measured.
**Do** keep VaganciaFitnessDebug as an independent diagnostic app.
donts: **Don’t** present synthetic captures as physical evidence or VoiceOver verification.
**Don’t** imitate Liquid Glass outside native iOS materials.
**Don’t** truncate units or sources at accessibility sizes.
**Don’t** turn planned targets or simulated data into physical measurements.
**Don’t** change VaganciaFitnessDebug installation identity or overwrite private original evidence.
